description:
muxr is an open-source companion for coding agents running through Herdr on a Mac or Linux computer you control.

Pair the app with your computer to:
• See which agents are working, waiting, or finished.
• Open live terminals and send prompts.
• Browse repository files and review changes.
• Start agents and use saved runbook commands.
• Receive completion and attention notifications.
• Use optional realtime voice through a provider configured on your own computer.

Your computer remains the source of truth. Terminal text, prompts, files, and attachments travel through the relay as end-to-end encrypted content. Pairing credentials are revocable, and optional provider credentials stay on the connected computer.

muxr requires Herdr and the public @trymuxr/cli package on the computer you want to control. Setup instructions are available at trymuxr.com/docs/setup.
promotionalText: Follow coding agents away from your desk: inspect live terminals, review files and changes, send prompts, and keep execution on your own computer.
whatsNew: Adds hardened computer collaboration, improved encrypted pairing and recovery, clearer background status, and more reliable realtime voice controls.
